what: known-answer tests of the cryptography in use
vectors_source: NIST ACVP-Server (github.com/usnistgov/ACVP-Server), gen-val/json-files/<algorithm>/internalProjection.json for ML-KEM-keyGen-FIPS203, ML-KEM-encapDecap-FIPS203, ML-DSA-keyGen-FIPS204, ML-DSA-sigGen-FIPS204, ML-DSA-sigVer-FIPS204; revision 975de31eb83d of 2026-08-12; fetched 2026-10-05. A work of the US Government (public domain).
vectors_selection: parameter sets ML-KEM-1024 and ML-DSA-87 only; of ML-DSA the external interface, pure (no pre-hash), which is the one this system uses; every test case of those groups. Large expected outputs are kept as SHA-256; inputs are whole.

groups.name: ML-KEM-1024 keyGen
groups.what: seed (d, z) -> encapsulation and decapsulation key

groups.name: ML-KEM-1024 encapsulation
groups.what: key, coins m -> ciphertext, shared secret

groups.name: ML-KEM-1024 decapsulation
groups.what: valid and modified ciphertexts -> shared secret (implicit rejection)

groups.name: ML-KEM-1024 encapsulation key check
groups.what: FIPS 203 7.2: a key with a coefficient out of range must be refused

groups.name: ML-KEM-1024 decapsulation key check
groups.what: FIPS 203 7.3: a key whose stored hash does not fit must be refused

groups.name: ML-DSA-87 sigGen
groups.what: secret key, message, context, rnd -> signature (15 deterministic, 15 hedged)

groups.name: ML-DSA-87 sigVer
groups.what: valid signatures, and message / commitment / z / hint modified -> accept or refuse

groups.name: random generator restored
groups.what: after the seeded tests liboqs draws from the system again

groups.name: HKDF-SHA-256 (crypto/keyschedule.py)
groups.what: RFC 5869 A.1 and A.3 (no salt, no info)

groups.name: AES-256-GCM
groups.what: GCM specification (McGrew, Viega) test cases 13, 14 and 16
